newsitem.title: USA: Texas Regional declares three-for-two split.
newsitem.headline: Texas Regional declares three-for-two split.

text.p: Texas Regional Bancshares Inc said on Friday that its directors had authorized a split of three shares of its $1.00 par value common stock for each two shares outstanding.
To effect the split, the directors also declared a stock dividend of one-half share of common stock for each share of common stock outstanding, payable August 21 to holders of record on July 31.
In a statement, the company added that its quarterly cash dividend of $0.11 per share will remain unchanged.
